get_available_gpus: get information about all available GPUs including memory, utilization, and name
estimate_gpu_requirements: estimate the number of GPUs and memory needed based on model paths for averaging
allocate_gpus: allocate GPUs for a task by checking free memory and utilization thresholds
release_gpus: release GPUs that were previously allocated to a specific task ID
get_gpu_status: get the current GPU allocation status with details on all GPUs and assigned tasks
